name: dg-agent

commands.description: make a one-time call card; the first ring it admits becomes a new contact

options.description: relays this card should use instead of the saved ones
hours until the card expires
self name this card carries instead of your saved one
handle to give the contact once the call is answered

commands.description: accept a call card: ring its owner and save them as a contact

existing key id to sign a new contact with, instead of the number key

commands.name: contacts
commands.description: list every contact, in handle order

commands.name: remove
commands.description: remove a contact; its stored messages stay

commands.description: send one message to a contact, or to a #group

options.description: your own extension, sent so replies route back (default DG_PHONE_AS)
send one PNG, JPEG, or WebP image instead of text

commands.description: check that a contact's or #group's listener answers; exit 1 when no receipt comes in time

commands.description: print whether text --image may send, or turn it on or off

commands.description: print whether beats, receipts, and ping answers go out, or turn them on or off

commands.description: print whether this phone exchanges rosters, or turn that on or off

commands.description: a store for PHI that agents can use but never read

commands.description: delete one vault item

commands.name: open
commands.description: human only: show an item on this terminal; refuses in an agent session or without a TTY

name of the new item; never overwrites (default <name>-out)

options.description: read as this extension: its messages plus the shared ones (default DG_PHONE_AS)

read as this extension: its messages plus the shared ones (default DG_PHONE_AS)

commands.description: print your self name, contact count, and unread message count
